parsed.note_claim: Politicians like Boris Johnson and Günter Sautter were on a separate chartered train not hit but stopped nearby as precaution.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Fast zeitgleich geriet ein weiterer Zug auf derselben Strecke in den Drohnenalarm. Nach Informationen des Spiegel, musste ein privat gecharterter Sonderzug unweit der Grenze stoppen.
parsed.reason: The article confirms the regular train was hit and distinguishes the politicians' separate chartered train which only stopped due to the alarm.
